description: Spain work permit / work visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services Honest guidance by SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: Spain work permit requirements for Pakistanis?
faqs.answer: Typically a Spanish employer authorization, complete personal documents, and the correct national visa. SK builds the checklist for your case.

faqs.question: Is Spanish mandatory?
faqs.answer: Often yes for local jobs. Some multinational roles accept English. We assess before you pay.

faqs.question: Seasonal agriculture visas?
faqs.answer: Some seasonal programs exist with strict employer rules. We only proceed with verifiable offers.

faqs.question: Visit vs work Spain?
faqs.answer: Visit visas forbid employment. Work needs authorization. Never mix the two.

body:
Spain work permit / work visa from Pakistan

Spain offers skilled and shortage pathways when employers complete authorization. Spanish language helps for most customer-facing roles.

Requirements

  • Spanish work authorization / contract from employer
  • Passport, forms, photos
  • Qualifications matching the occupation
  • Medical / police certificates when requested
  • Translations and legalization as required

Process

  1. Employer authorization review
  2. Pakistan document packaging
  3. Visa appointment prep
  4. Biometrics and decision tracking
  5. Arrival steps briefing

Documents

  • Passport and photos
  • Contract / authorization papers
  • CV, degrees, experience letters
  • Police / medical as instructed
  • Fee and insurance proof

Related checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

SK from PKR 80,000. Official fees separate.

Timeline

Often 2–6 months depending on authorization speed.

Common mistakes

  • Fake job letters from unlicensed brokers
  • Ignoring Spanish language needs
  • Incomplete apostille chains
  • Tourist entry for work

Work route reality check for Spain

Work authorisation is not a tourist conversion.

SK Immigration helps with CV packaging, document checklists and appointment prep. We do not sell fake job guarantees. Employers and missions decide.

Before you pay anyone

  • Confirm the job/contract type matches the visa subclass
  • Language level matches employer expectations
  • Educational documents follow the correct attestation chain
  • You understand SK fees vs medical/government fees
